notes: Dinoctor now opens with a fresh, empty project.
Changing style asks first: keep your shots or start fresh, and save before.
Pick several shots at once and delete them together.
Automatic backups for every project, in an Auto-Save folder next to it.
A + button on every sample adds it in one click.
Grain is off in samples by default. Add it back any time.
Properties open right away for a newly added item.
Connect Dinoctor to Claude or Cursor in one click.
Notices and updates like this one, which you can stop at any time.
